function.name: agent
function.description: Start a sub-agent on a plan node: for work that would cost you a lot of context for a small answer (reading a long log, scanning a large file), or for work on Y that does not depend on X, so X continues. Add the node with plan_add first, then agent({node:"<id>"}): the node's title, details and done_when are the child's whole brief (it cannot see your conversation), and it publishes its answer onto the node. It spends its own context; what it read never enters yours. isolation none: it has your tools, in your tree. worktree and docker: your tools, in its own tree. dir puts it in another directory, a git worktree of that directory's repo with worktree. nodir: NO project and NO file tools; its shell runs in a scratch dir, deleted on dismiss. Never use nodir for work that reads or edits project files. If a child drops its node with "missing tools", start it again with isolation none or worktree. It returns at once and you are notified each time the child ends a turn, unless wait:true. Then act on it by id: agent({id:N, tell:"…"}) answers its question or gives it new work, node gives it another plan node, resume restarts a stopped one, dismiss:true ends it. It stays resident until you dismiss it; nothing cleans it up for you. Default model: qwen3-8b on provider local. Default effort: low.

dir.description: a new child's directory, absolute, ~/ or relative to your workspace (default: your workspace). With isolation none it works there in place; with worktree or docker its worktree is branched from that directory's git repository, and it works in the same subdirectory of it

dismiss.description: with id: end it; what it did not finish of a plan node goes back

effort.description: how much this child thinks before it answers: none is fastest, max thinks most, lowest is the least the model allows, default leaves it to the server

id.description: act on existing agent #id instead of starting one

isolation.description: where the child works. none (default): this tree. worktree: its own git worktree branched from this tree's last commit (uncommitted changes are not in it); it commits there and you merge its branch — use it for children that edit at the same time. docker: the same, its commands in a container. nodir: no project, no file tools, shell in a scratch dir deleted on dismiss; only for work that needs no project files.

model.description: run this child on a specific model

node.description: the plan node a new child works: a ready one (todo, no child on it, its needs done). Its title, details and done_when are the child's brief; it owns the node alone and owes you a publish of it (done with notes, or dropped with why); the node leaves your ready list. It gets plan tools that change only its own nodes. With id: give idle agent #id this node; tell adds to its brief

provider.description: run this child on another logged-in provider (then name one of its models); omitted, it runs on this session's provider

resume.description: with id: restart a stopped agent from its transcript

tell.description: with id: its next message: the answer to its question, or new work

wait.description: block until it answers, instead of being notified later
